arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} While in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} quickly gain Infernal Hunger stacks, each increasing the damage you take by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|1%|]{/c}. Killing enemies or hitting Bosses converts Infernal Hunger stacks into Demonic Strength, each granting {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|x%|]{/c} increased Damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
